BiblicalUsage: Pinon was a chief of Edom, named in the genealogy of Esau in Genesis 36:41 and again in 1 Chronicles 1:52. He is listed among the dukes of Edom — a name, a title, and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even Edom's chiefs are counted in God's book.
